title: Naturality of the pure-normalized tensor-chain comparison

source.place: Steps 1 and 2; naturality of the pure-normalized chain tensor comparison.

statement: For any scheme isomorphism and finite or completed coefficient stage, take closed structures and K-flat tensor models [def-pod-reindexing-coherence-data, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], and tensor comparison data whose chain maps send each pure generator to its reindexed generator [lem-pod-reindexing-comparison-core-tensor-data]. For arbitrary complexes P,L,P′,L′ and chain maps f:P→P′, h:L→L′, reindexing the total-tensor map followed by the chain comparison for P′,L′ equals the chain comparison for P,L followed by the total tensor of the two reindexed maps. No K-flatness or boundedness is required.

proof.text: Cancel the invertible comparison for P,L. In each total degree use extensionality on all pure-tensor summands. The inverse comparison sends a target pure generator to the corresponding source generator, by its pure normalization and inverse identity. The formula for total tensor maps on generators and pure normalization for both comparisons identify the two images. This proves the equality degreewise.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_chain_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (t : ComparisonCoreTensorData l E g s SX SY TX TY)
    {P L P' L' : K l E Y s} (f : P ⟶ P') (h : L ⟶ L') :
    (podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).map ((total l E Y s).map (f, h)) ≫
        (t.tensorChain P' L').hom =
      (t.tensorChain P L).hom ≫ (total l E X s).map
        ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).map f,
          (podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).map h)
